description: Purchasing this digital gift card creates a unique REDEMPTION code! This gift card can ONLY be used for candle classes! Please read: 1) Gift the REDEMPTION code to your special person. Come into the store and I can give you a nice card and envelope to write the code to present them! 2) You will purchase the gift card and receive the REDEMPTION code via email (ignore the confirmation code email that’s just an order code for you, saying your purchase went through. The REDEMPTION code is what is important and is the code your person will need) :) 3) The gift card recipient can pick whatever class they want, and when checking out will enter this REDEMPTION code at checkout. NOT the confirmation code! Candle classes are $67 and Monday night classes are $45. For one candle class seat, purchase the $45/$67 amount. For two candle class seats, purchase the $134 amount, and so on :) This gift card never expires. Thank you so much!
